usage: sot-validator audit [-h] {verify,head} ...

positional arguments:
  {verify,head}
    verify       Walk the audit-log hash chain and report the first break (exit 0 intact, 1 broken
                 or unchained).
    head         Print the audit-log chain head as COUNT:HASH for use as a later `audit verify
                 --anchor`.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
